title: Coordinate ratio bound
statement: Let $n,C,Q$ be nonnegative integers, let $t>0$, and let $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$. Suppose $n\geq 1$, $1/(Q+1)\leq\varepsilon$, and $t\leq(C+1)(\sqrt{\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1)$. Define $d=\lceil 8t/\varepsilon\rceil$ and $\theta=(\varepsilon/8)^2t^{-2}(1/9)^d$. Then $2t/\theta\leq 2^{(128(Q+1)^2(C+1)^3+4[8(C+1)(Q+1)+1]+3)(\sqrt{\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1)}$.
